name: Order Desk Daily Orders to Database
description: Fetch new or recently modified Order Desk orders every day, normalize order fields, and bulk import them into the CellX database.

nodes.name: Daily Schedule
nodes.notes: Run once per day. Suggested time: 6 AM Pacific after marketplace/order platform syncs settle.

nodes.name: Order Desk Fetch Orders
nodes.notes: Fetch recent orders from Order Desk. Store credentials only in backend env vars ORDERDESK_STORE_ID and ORDERDESK_API_KEY; do not paste keys into this template.

nodes.name: CellX Bulk Import Orders
nodes.notes: Upsert normalized Order Desk orders into cx_orderdesk_order. Create this table with matching columns first if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: View CellX Orders
nodes.notes: Read the current OrderDesk order rows stored in CellX after the import finishes.

integrationSettings.sortBy: order_date desc, updated_date desc, id desc

nodes.name: Sync Summary
nodes.notes: Create a compact sync summary for logs or email notifications.

nodes.name: Write Workflow Log
nodes.notes: Record the daily Order Desk sync result.
